Services · Working together

Services: from an idea to a running AI and web product

I build AI and web products from idea to operation: UX, frontend, backend, database, deployment. Everything here is backed by my own products and notes on this site, not by promises.

Four services

AI prototype and MVP

An idea becomes a working prototype with a clear scope: the essentials first, so you get real feedback early. A tightly scoped prototype typically takes about 3–6 weeks; we settle the exact effort after the first call.

Proof: MeisterMeld (voice-first software for tradespeople) and PflegeOasis.

AI integration with human oversight

Building language models into existing workflows without giving up control: a draft by AI, review and approval by a person. This also fits the transparency duties of the EU AI Act.

Proof: AI content with human-in-the-loop, AI Act Article 50 and the AI routine-work calculator.

Web product with backend and SEO

Landing pages, UX flows, database and backend, local search engine optimisation, payment logic and a sensibly cut MVP scope from one pair of hands.

Proof: this website with automatic deployment and the products MeisterMeld and PflegeOasis.

Servers, deployment and operations

Your own server or a VPS with CI/CD, secure access and backups whose restore has been tested. Anyone who does not want everything in the big providers’ cloud will find a practical route here.

Proof: leaving the cloud, zero trust for the homelab and backup the 3-2-1 way.

How working together goes

  1. First call (30 minutes): goal, users, constraints. You can book a slot directly on the home page.
  2. Fix the scope: what goes into the first version and what deliberately does not? In writing and short.
  3. Build and show a prototype: in short steps, so you see early whether the direction is right.
  4. Go live and operate: deployment, backups, monitoring; documentation of the processes on request.

What I am not

  • I work alone, not an agency with a large team. That keeps coordination short but limits the volume.
  • I quote prices after the first call because they depend on scope. No flat offers without knowing the project.
  • Legal questions (for example on the CRA, NIS2 or the AI Act) are for legal counsel; I show what belongs on the technical side.

For employers

I am also looking for a permanent IT job, with DevOps and platform engineering as the best fit. My background, open gaps and evidence are summarised in career change into DevOps in Germany; the CV is available as a PDF (English).
